feedback: Static rows: re-tag the 12 no-HTTP-surface assertions from api to unit so they leave the sprint contract and are enforced by the architecture suite instead, matching how VM-010 already treats the backend float scanner.

NFR rigor: promote VM-001, VM-003, VM-004 and VM-005 to carry api evidence on top of unit — PII-free logs, correlation id with and without an inbound header, and GET /health under 1 s are all observable over a served request.

Concurrency: accept as untested for v1 — disbursement idempotence rests on the UNIQUE constraint on loan id and repayment allocation on FIFO plus the applied_principal + applied_interest = amount CHECK constraint, both structural, so a concurrent writer corrupts nothing even unproven.
changes: Re-tagged 12 matrix rows api -> unit (VM-020..023 policy-version immutability and migration lint, VM-031..034 invariant registry / git provenance / gate attestation, VM-050 scoring-stub collaborators, VM-081 schedule_installment scan, VM-106..107 SLO report and registry completeness) and renamed their checks CHK-*-api -> CHK-*-unit. Those 12 rows were dropped from the proposed sprint-contract checks: contract-freeze requires Observe to parse as METHOD /path → status, and they assert over source, migrations, git history or a written report rather than a served request.

Promoted VM-001, VM-003, VM-004 and VM-005 from unit-only to unit+api, adding four CHK-*-api checks and four Observe cells (POST /applications with synthetic PAN/Aadhaar/salary content and a 0-occurrence log-buffer assertion; GET /products with and without X-Request-ID; GET /health under 1 s).

Filled the review surface: 29 named Ports-and-Adapters seams with real and test-double adapters, 84 proposed evaluator checks with Observe, 14 explicitly-untested areas each with a reason, environment assumptions (injected as-of date, Decimal 2dp money, 60-min JWT, no network egress, Chromium-only) and a 7-point sprint pass/fail. Recorded the three layer decisions in the plan itself so it is self-explaining. Final layers: 50 api, 26 e2e, 22 unit, 4 api+unit, 3 e2e+accessibility, 1 api+performance, 1 unit+performance.
declined: Did not add a concurrency acceptance criterion: that is a new AC, which waits until /test closes and then belongs to /spec, not an in-phase rewrite. Did not invent proxy endpoints for the 12 static rows, which would have fabricated a runtime check for something that is not one. Did not run the --eval artifact evaluator: it was not requested on this invocation.

feedback: Group A's frozen contract named endpoints built in later groups, so the group could never pass. Retarget the correlation-id checks to /health and drop VM-001's api evidence, which has no available surface in its own group.
changes: Corrected an ordering defect introduced by the earlier layer promotion. QA-VM-003 and QA-VM-004 observed GET /products, built by E1-S1 in group B, and QA-VM-001 observed POST /applications, built by E4-S1 in group E, while all three were frozen into group A (E15-S1, E9-S1, E11-S1). Retargeted QA-VM-003 and QA-VM-004 to GET /health, the only endpoint E15-S1 builds in its own group; correlation-id propagation is endpoint-agnostic so the evidence is unchanged in kind.

Reverted VM-001 (no PII in logs) to unit-only and removed its CHK-VM-001-api check and its proposed-check row: its api evidence would require an endpoint that accepts PAN, Aadhaar and salary content, and the only one is POST /applications five groups later. It is proven at the log-capture fixture E15-S1 produces, with VM-002 asserting the redaction filter is installed on 100% of loggers. Group A's contract is now GET /health x3, every check satisfiable by the story that lands it. Recorded the general rule in the plan: an evaluator check may only name an endpoint that exists by the end of the group it is frozen into.
declined: Did not revert all four promotions, which would have left group A with no api checks and discarded the reviewed NFR rigor. Did not re-group the checks into the groups that build their endpoints: contract-freeze derives a check's group from its matrix row's story, so moving them would decouple a story's AC from the story's own group.
